choices.reasoning: Discard Helicarrier - it costs 3 physical resources but we only have 1 physical card in hand (itself, which can't pay for itself). It's too expensive to play early.

Keep the hand. We have a good mix: Black Cat for early ally presence, Aunt May for healing in alter-ego, Interrogation Room for cheap threat removal, Enhanced Spider-Sense for treachery protection, and Swinging Web Kick as a strong finisher. Resources: 3 energy, 2 mental, plus Peter Parker's mental resource per round.
Play Black Cat as an early ally. Costs 2 energy - I have 4 energy cards in hand (Black Cat, Aunt May, Interrogation Room, For Justice!). Will discard two energy cards to pay.

Pay with Aunt May (energy) and Interrogation Room (energy). This preserves Swinging Web Kick, Enhanced Spider-Sense, For Justice!, and Peter Parker's ability for later. Aunt May and Interrogation Room are both 1-cost situational supports.

End turn as alter-ego. I have no more alter-ego cards to play (remaining hand: Swinging Web Kick, Enhanced Spider-Sense, For Justice! are all Hero only). Black Cat attacking for 1 damage isn't worth exhausting her. Staying alter-ego lets me draw 3 cards and Rhino only schemes (adds threat) rather than attacks. Main scheme threshold is 7, we can afford some threat.
Hand has 3 cards, hand size is 6. No need to discard. Draw up to 6.

Must change form to Spider-Man. Main scheme is at 4/7 threat. If I stay alter-ego, villain phase adds 1 (per round) + Rhino SCH 1 + boost (1-2) = 3-4 threat, reaching 7-8 and losing. As hero, Rhino attacks instead of scheming. Then I can use basic THW to clear Crowd Control (2 threat, Crisis icon blocking main scheme threat removal).

Basic thwart with Spider-Man to remove 1 threat from Crowd Control (exhausts Spider-Man). Crowd Control has 2 threat and Crisis icon blocking main scheme threat removal. Need to clear it. Then follow up with Black Cat thwart for the second threat.

Black Cat thwart to remove the last 1 threat from Crowd Control. Exhausts Black Cat, she takes 1 consequential damage (goes to 1 HP). This clears the Crisis side scheme, allowing main scheme threat removal again.

Play Swinging Web Kick targeting Rhino for 8 damage. Costs 3 mental. I have 4 mental cards + Peter Parker ability. Will pay with Enhanced Spider-Sense, Nick Fury, and Peter Parker ability, preserving one Swinging Web Kick for later. Rhino at 14 HP -> 6 HP.

Pay with Enhanced Spider-Sense (mental), Nick Fury (mental), and Swinging Web Kick (mental) - three mental resources. This preserves one Swinging Web Kick, For Justice!, and Mockingbird. Discards treachery cancel and temporary ally, but deals 8 damage to Rhino (14->6).
Hand has 2 cards (For Justice!, Mockingbird), hero hand size is 5. No need to discard. Draw up to 5.

Defend with Spider-Man. DEF 3 reduces damage significantly. Rhino ATK 2 + boost - 3 DEF = boost - 1 damage. Average boost is 1-2, so likely 0-1 damage. Black Cat only has 1 HP and would likely die. Spider-Man is already exhausted from thwarting, so defending doesn't cost additional actions next turn.
Defend with Black Cat. She has 1 HP left, takes all 3 damage from Vulture, dies, excess damage lost. Spider-Man takes 0 damage. Better than taking 3 damage myself.

Play Mockingbird (cost 3 physical). Pay with Backflip (physical) and Web-Shooter (physical). She enters, stuns Vulture (preventing his attack next villain phase). Then she can thwart main scheme for 1 threat (5->4), taking 1 consequential damage. This survives the villain phase (main scheme 4+2=6).

Pay with Backflip (physical), The Power of Justice (wild), Web-Shooter (physical). Wild counts as physical, giving 3 physical equivalent. Keeps Emergency (0-cost interrupt to reduce villain scheme threat) in hand. Mockingbird enters play, stuns Vulture.
Stun Vulture. He has ATK 3 and will attack next villain phase. Stunning him prevents that attack. Rhino ATK 2+boost is less dangerous, and Spider-Man DEF 3 can handle it.
Mockingbird thwarts main scheme The Break-In! for 1 threat (5->4). Exhausts Mockingbird, she takes 1 consequential damage (3->2 HP). This ensures main scheme at 4, next villain phase +2 = 6, survive.

End turn. Main scheme at 4/7. Mockingbird at 2 HP (exhausted). Spider-Man exhausted. Villain phase: main scheme +2 threat (1 base + 1 acceleration) = 6. Vulture stunned (no attack). Rhino attacks Spider-Man (ready at end of turn).
Hand has 1 card (Emergency), hand size 5. Draw 4 cards.

Defend with Spider-Man. DEF 3 vs Rhino ATK 2 + boost. Damage = boost - 1. Likely 0-1 damage. Mockingbird only has 2 HP and would die to a moderate boost. Spider-Man can afford the damage and will ready at end of next player phase.

Play Jessica Jones (cost 3). Pay with Emergency (energy), Interrogation Room (energy), First Aid (mental) = 3 resources. She enters with +1 THW per side scheme (Highway Robbery) = THW 2. Then she can thwart main scheme for 2 threat (6->4). Mockingbird can then thwart for 1 more (4->3). Survives villain phase (3+2=5).
Pay with Emergency (energy), First Aid (mental), Interrogation Room (energy). Three resources for cost 3. Keeps Daredevil and Webbed Up in hand.
Jessica Jones thwarts main scheme The Break-In! for 2 threat (6->4). Exhausts her, takes 1 consequential damage (3->2 HP).
Mockingbird thwarts main scheme for 1 threat (4->3). Exhausts her, takes 1 consequential damage (2->1 HP). Main scheme at 3, villain phase +2 = 5, survive.

End turn. Main scheme at 3/7. Both allies exhausted (Jessica Jones 2 HP, Mockingbird 1 HP). Spider-Man exhausted. Villain phase: main scheme +2 = 5. Vulture attacks (ATK 3), Rhino attacks (ATK 5 with Charge, overkill). Spider-Man will ready at end of turn? No, end of player phase readies. But we're ending player phase now, so everything readies. Then villain phase: Spider-Man ready, can defend.
Hand has 2 cards (Daredevil, Webbed Up), hand size 5. Draw 3 cards.
Do not respond. Main scheme at 3, +2 = 5/7. Still safe. Save Great Responsibility for later when threat is closer to threshold.

Defend with Spider-Man. Rhino ATK 5 (with Charge) + boost. DEF 3 reduces to 2+boost damage. Charge discarded after this attack. Spider-Man at 9 HP can take 3-4 damage. Allies are low HP and Rhino has overkill, so defending with them would pass excess damage to Spider-Man.
Defend with Mockingbird (1 HP). She takes 3 damage, dies, excess lost (Vulture has no overkill). Spider-Man stays at 6 HP. Jessica Jones preserved at 2 HP.
Defend with Jessica Jones (2 HP). She takes Rhino's attack (ATK 2 + boost, likely 3-4 damage), dies, excess lost. Spider-Man stays at 6 HP. Charge is discarded so no overkill.

Play For Justice! targeting The Break-In! (main scheme). Cost 2. Pay with Haymaker (energy) + one Great Responsibility (mental). Includes mental resource, so removes 4 threat (5->1). This survives villain phase threat (1+2=3). Keeps one Great Responsibility, Daredevil, Webbed Up, Surveillance Team.

Pay with Haymaker (energy) and Great Responsibility (mental). Includes mental resource, so For Justice! removes 4 threat (main scheme 5->1). Keeps one Great Responsibility, Daredevil, Webbed Up, Surveillance Team.

End turn. Main scheme at 1/7. Hand 4 cards, draw 1. Spider-Man readies. Villain phase: main scheme +2 = 3. Rhino attacks first - choose no defender (take 2+boost, stay ready). Vulture attacks - defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3 vs ATK 3 = 0). Survive if Rhino boost 0 (2 damage, 3->1 HP).
Hand has 4 cards, hand size 5. Draw 1.

Do not respond. Let main scheme go to 3/7. Spider-Man at 3 HP. Villain phase: Rhino attacks first - no defender (take 2+boost, stay ready). Vulture attacks - defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3 vs ATK 3 = 0). Survive if boost 0 (2 damage, 3->1 HP).
No defender. Take Rhino's attack (2+boost) undefended, stay ready for Vulture. Spider-Man at 3 HP. Need boost 0 to survive (2 damage -> 1 HP).
Defend with Spider-Man. DEF 3 vs Vulture ATK 3 = 0 damage. Spider-Man survives at 1 HP. Stun remains (removed on next attack). Exhausts Spider-Man.

choices.reasoning: Strong opening hand with good resource spread and powerful cards: Backflip (0-cost damage prevention), Mockingbird (3-cost ally with stun), Aunt May (healing in alter-ego), plus multiple threat removal options (Surveillance Team, Interrogation Room, Spider-Tracer). No need to mulligan.

Play Aunt May (cost 1 energy) by discarding Spider-Tracer (energy). Aunt May provides an Alter-Ego Action to heal 4 damage, which is valuable for sustain. Spider-Tracer is less useful early with no minions in play yet.
Pay for Aunt May using Spider-Tracer (energy resource). This matches the plan to discard Spider-Tracer since it's less useful early without minions in play.

Cannot play any more cards this turn (no resources to pay for Surveillance Team, Mockingbird, or Interrogation Room). End turn in alter-ego to draw cards and prepare for hero form next turn. Villain will scheme for 2 threat (1 per round + Rhino SCH 1), bringing main scheme to 2/7.
Hand has 4 cards, hand size is 6. No need to discard. Draw 2 cards.
Play Web-Shooter (cost 1 physical) for recurring wild resources in hero form. Will pay with Backflip (physical) since Web-Shooter provides long-term value while Backflip is a one-time interrupt.
Pay for Web-Shooter using Backflip (physical resource). Web-Shooter provides 3 wild resources over time in hero form, which is excellent for resource generation.

Play Interrogation Room (cost 1 energy) for passive threat removal when minions are defeated. Will pay with Black Cat (energy) since Interrogation Room provides ongoing value against the Hydra Mercenary and future minions.
Pay for Interrogation Room using Black Cat (energy resource). Interrogation Room will automatically remove threat when Hydra Mercenary and future minions are defeated.

Change to Spider-Man (hero form) to stop the heavy threat accumulation (4+ per round in alter-ego vs 1 per round in hero). Main scheme is at 3/7. As hero, I can THW for 2 to bring it to 1, then manage threat while fighting Hydra Mercenary (Guard) and Rhino.

Play Surveillance Team (cost 2) paying with Mockingbird (physical) and Web-Shooter ability (wild - exhaust Web-Shooter, remove 1 counter). Surveillance Team provides 3 threat removal actions without exhausting Spider-Man, freeing him to attack/defend. Then use its action immediately to remove 1 threat (main scheme 3→2).
Use Surveillance Team action: exhaust and remove a counter to remove 1 threat from The Break-In! (main scheme). Brings threat from 3 to 2.

End turn while ready. Villain phase: main scheme +1 (2→3). Rhino and Hydra Mercenary attack. Spider-Man ready, can defend against one attack with DEF (likely 2), taking reduced damage from one and full from the other (~3 total damage). HP 10→~7. Next turn: Surveillance Team and Web-Shooter ready, can remove another threat and attack Hydra.

Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3). Rhino base ATK 2 + boost. DEF 3 likely reduces damage to 0 or 1. Spider-Man exhausts. Hydra Mercenary will attack next (ATK 1 + boost 1), will take full damage (~2) while exhausted. Total ~2-3 damage, HP 10→7-8. Acceptable.

Play Enhanced Spider-Sense (interrupt) to deal with Gang-Up's Hero effect: Rhino and Hydra Mercenary attack again. Spider-Man is exhausted, would take ~5 damage. Enhanced Spider-Sense likely prevents or mitigates this.
Pay for Enhanced Spider-Sense using Web-Shooter ability (wild resource). Exhaust Web-Shooter, remove 1 counter (2→1). Preserves hand cards for future use.

Use Surveillance Team: exhaust and remove a counter to remove 1 threat from The Break-In! (3→2). Surveillance Team has 2 counters left. This doesn't exhaust Spider-Man, so he can still attack Hydra Mercenary this turn.
Basic attack: Spider-Man deals 2 damage to Hydra Mercenary (3→1 HP). Exhausts Spider-Man. Hydra has Guard, so must be defeated before attacking Rhino. Next turn can finish it off.

Cancel - I misread the options. Option 1 was "Play For Justice!" not "Basic attack". The basic attack option is no longer available after using Surveillance Team. Need to go back and choose a different action or end turn.

Play For Justice! targeting The Break-In! Hero Action (thwart) removes 3 threat (4 if paid with mental). Main scheme at 2 threat, so 3 removes it to 0. Pay with Energy card (energy,energy) - one card from hand.
Pay for For Justice! using Energy card (energy,energy). Removes 3 threat from main scheme (2→0). Preserves Avengers Mansion, Emergency, Webbed Up for future.
End turn. Main scheme at 0 threat. Villain phase: +1 threat (0→1). Rhino and Hydra Mercenary attack. Spider-Man ready (DEF 3), can defend against one attack. HP 9, can handle damage.

Play Emergency (interrupt) to respond to Advance treachery making Rhino scheme for 3 threat. Main scheme at 1, would go to 4. Preventing this threat is valuable.

Play Swinging Web Kick targeting Hydra Mercenary (cost 3 mental). Hero Action (attack): deal 8 damage. Hydra has 1 HP, will be defeated. Interrogation Room triggers: remove 1 threat (3→2). Guard removed, can attack Rhino next. Will pay with Avengers Mansion (mental) + Peter Parker ability (mental) + Web-Shooter ability (wild as mental).

Pay for Swinging Web Kick using Avengers Mansion (mental), Spider-Tracer (energy), and Web-Shooter ability (wild). Discards Avengers Mansion and Spider-Tracer from hand, uses last Web-Shooter counter (discards Web-Shooter). Keeps Webbed Up for future. Defeats Hydra Mercenary (1 HP) with 8 damage.

Use Surveillance Team: exhaust and remove last counter to remove 1 threat from The Break-In! (2→1). Surveillance Team then discarded (empty). Main scheme at 1, villain phase adds 1 → 2. Only Rhino attacks next.
End turn. Main scheme at 1. Villain phase: +1 threat (1→2). Only Rhino attacks. Spider-Man ready (DEF 3), can defend for minimal damage. HP 8 is healthy. No need to flip to alter-ego.

Play Great Responsibility (interrupt) to prevent 1 threat from being placed on main scheme. Keeps threat lower.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3). Rhino ATK 2 + boost. Damage = max(0, boost-1). Likely 0 or 1 damage. HP 7→6-7.

Change form to Peter Parker (alter-ego). Spider-Man at 3 HP, stunned. Use Aunt May (Alter-Ego Action: exhaust to heal 4) to heal to 7 HP. Stun status carries over but doesn't affect alter-ego. Accept increased threat this villain phase (per-round + Rhino SCH + boost ~3-4 threat), but main scheme threshold is 7, currently at ~1-2, so can survive 1-2 rounds. Next turn flip back to hero to control threat.

End turn. HP 7. Villain phase: threat increases. Next turn flip to Spider-Man.

Change form to Spider-Man (hero). Main scheme at 4/7. In alter-ego, threat gains ~3-4 per round (would lose next villain phase). In hero, only +1 per round. Must flip now to control threat. HP 7 is decent.

Play Webbed Up targeting Rhino (cost 4). When Rhino attacks, Webbed Up discards and stuns Rhino, negating the attack and stunning him for next villain phase too. Buys two safe turns. Will pay with Genius (mental,mental), Peter Parker ability (mental), and Web-Shooter (physical) or similar.
